Allus n tuqqna s wudem awurman
Yettekkes ahewwel n ugilal seg usawaḍ-ik send ad yettwazen.
S wacḥal ara yegzem usemsas n Speex. Yettwaseqdac kan ma tukksa n uhewwel tettwasbadu ɣer Fessus.
Seqdec daɣen tukksa n uhewwel n tiliɣri-k ɣef usawaḍ.
Seqdec daɣen asenqed awurman n ubleɣ n tiliɣri-k ɣef usawaḍ.
Isenqaden-nniḍen n tigezmi-a qqnen ɣer ufran-a.
Anda tella tlist gar uhewwel n ugilal yettwaktalen d taɣect-ik yettwaktalen. Ma tuli, ilaq ad d-tbanaḍ akteṛ ɣef texxamt; ma tris, ad iɛeddi ugar. Afeggag ddaw-a yeskan-d i sin ticraḍ ttmuddun.
Yettkemmil ad yektel ableɣ n texxamt, yettsenkiz tilist yid-s. Sens-it akken ad tesbaduḍ aswir s ufus.
Aswir n texxamt ara yettwaktalen seg-s tilist, s dB ddaw n uswir afellay. Yettwaseqdac kan ma \"Ḍfeṛ ahewwel n ugilal\" yensa.
Yettettu ayen yettwalemden ɣef texxamt d taɣect-ik, yebda aktal seg tazwara.
Acḥal ilaq ad yeqqim yiwen n yimesli send ad yettwaḥseb d taɣect. Iɣewwaren iɣezfanen ttḥebbisen isitiyen n unasiw; yal aḥric ad yekkes 10 ms seg tazwara n wawal.
Kemmel tuzna akud-a mi ara tebru taɣect-ik ddaw n tlist, akken ur ttwagezmen ara yiḥbas deg tefyirt.
Tazmert n taɣect ara yebdun deg-s tuzna.
Tazmert n taɣect ddaw-s ara teḥbes tuzna.
Aswir n usawaḍ srid s ticraḍ n ugilal d tlist.
Asawaḍ ulac-it — tasiregt txuṣ, neɣ asnas-nniḍen yettseqdac-it.
Taɣect-ik tuli kra kan ɣef texxamt. Qerreb ɣer tiliɣri neɣ ssusem taxxamt.
Yessekcam-d taɣect-ik yettwasemsen mi ara yili yermed. Seqdec akask — s umeslaw ad d-yessuɣu.

Ayen ara yexdem tqeffalt n tɣuri/usteɛfu n ukask s ufeggag neɣ s Bluetooth mi ara tiliḍ teqqneḍ, ula d mi ara yensi ugdil. Sit fell-as: taqeffalt ara tṭṭfeḍ ur txeddem kra, acku Android yefka asiti aɣezfan i umalal n taɣect. Tettbeddil — yiwen n usiti ad tt-yessermed, wayeḍ ad tt-yessens — mi ara ttazent tqeffalin n \"sit akken ad temmeslayeḍ\" ɣef ugdil d tidet kan skud tṭṭfeḍ-tent, ala ma \"Taqeffalt n Sit akken ad temmeslayeḍ tusmimt\" termed.
Ulac — eǧǧ tiqeffalin n umidya i usnas n uẓawan
Beddel \"sit akken ad temmeslayeḍ\", neɣ sgugem deg yiskaren-nniḍen n tuzna
Seqdec akask n Bluetooth s wudem awurman

Azen yerna rmes taɣect s ukask n Bluetooth yeqqnen mi ara tiliḍ teqqneḍ ɣer uqeddac, yerna ɛeddi ɣer ukask ara yeqqnen deg usiwel. Ibenk n imesli n usiwel yezmer ad yettwabeddel seg wumuɣ n ubadu. Yessutur tasiregt n yibenkan iqerben; kra n yibenkan ur ttaznen ara imesli ɣer ukask war-s.
Nomla d amsaɣ n Mumble i Android. Yettwasiweḍ-d seg Mumla, yerna yettwaɛawed tira-s qrib meṛṛa.
Nomla d aseɣzan ilelli s turagt-a
I usmekti n Andreas Mandalka (Natenom), win akken imnirag-is, iqeddacen-is d ṣṣbeṛ-is ɛawnen aṭas n medden ad afen abrid ɣer Mumble.
